Build scope

What Pharmacy Fit-Out includes

Every fixture supports fast dispensing, secure storage, clear customer movement and licensing readiness.

01Dispensing counterL-shaped, U-shaped or island layout.
02Controlled storageLocked, alarmed and access-restricted cabinets.
03Climate zonesTemperature control for sensitive medication.
04Wall finishesAntibacterial and washable surfaces.
05FlooringAnti-slip, easy-clean vinyl or commercial tile.
06Pharmacy lightingGlare-free 4000K–5000K light for labels.
07Signage and brandingDGDA/PBMC-focused signs and brand touchpoints.
08SecurityCCTV, alarms and restricted-access areas.

A controlled programme

6 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Survey and brief

Review the unit, counter type, storage and brand needs.

02

Design and 3D

Approve the counter, shelving, lighting and finishes.

03

Compliance check

Review controlled storage, hygiene, signage and dispensing needs.

04

Construction and MEP

Coordinate floors, ceilings, power, HVAC and joinery.

05

Finishing and branding

Install surfaces, shelving, graphics and security systems.

06

Handover

Snag, clean and prepare the pharmacy for inspection.

Indicative PKR pricing

A practical range before the survey

These planning figures come from the service scope. The proposal is fixed only after site review and specification approval.

Basic PharmacyPKR 5,500–7,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 5.5M–7M
Mid-Spec PharmacyPKR 7,000–9,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 7M–9M
Premium / ChainPKR 9,000–12,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 9M–12M

Examples use a 1,000 sq. ft. unit. Final cost depends on counter layout, storage, security and specification.

Practical answers

Pharmacy Fit-Out FAQs

Six short answers about scope, timing and cost.

A 1,000 sq. ft. pharmacy typically ranges from PKR 5.5M to 12M, depending on specification and joinery.

An independent pharmacy takes 4–6 weeks. A chain prototype often takes 6–8 weeks.

We design around DGDA and PBMC requirements for storage, dispensing, hygiene, signage and security.

Yes. We create a repeatable counter, storage, lighting, finish and signage system.

Fit-out completes a new shell. Renovation updates a pharmacy that is already built or trading.

Yes. Woodex Furniture™ can manufacture L-shaped, U-shaped or island counters with integrated secure storage.
